proof_body:
by
  intro a
  have abel : ∀ x₀ x : ℝ, (∃ S : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n * x₀ ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds S)) → |x| < |x₀| → Summable (fun n => |a n * x ^ n|) := by
    rintro x₀ x ⟨S, hS⟩ hx
    have hz : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a n * x₀ ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h₁ := (hS.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)).sub hS
      simpa [Function.comp_def, Finset.sum_range_succ] using h₁
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hz.norm.bddAbove_range
    have hx₀ : 0 < |x₀| := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg _) hx
    have hr₀ : 0 ≤ |x| / |x₀| := div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hx₀.le
    have hr₁ : |x| / |x₀| < 1 := (div_lt_one hx₀).2 hx
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => abs_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_) ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr₀ hr₁).mul_left M)
    have hne : |x₀| ≠ 0 := hx₀.ne'
    have h₁ : |a n * x ^ n| = |a n * x₀ ^ n| * (|x| / |x₀|) ^ n := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_pow, div_pow]
      field_simp
    rw [h₁]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM (Set.mem_range_self n)) (pow_nonneg hr₀ n)
  refine ⟨sSup {r | ∃ x : ℝ, (∃ S : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n * x ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds S)) ∧ r = ENNReal.ofReal |x|}, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨r, ⟨x₀, hs, rfl⟩, hr⟩ := lt_sSup_iff.1 hx
    exact abel x₀ x hs ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg x)).1 hr)
  · intro x hx hs
    exact absurd hx (not_lt.2 (le_sSup ⟨x, hs, rfl⟩))
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ), ∃ R : ENNReal, (∀ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal |x| < R → Summable (fun n => |a n * x ^ n|)) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, R < ENNReal.ofReal |x| → ¬ ∃ S : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n * x ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds S))
